description:
IMMEDIATE JOINERS ONLY >>> VILE PARLE (EAST), MUMBAI 
 About Unilights 
 Unilights is a bespoke lighting design and manufacturing company working at the intersection of architectural lighting, premium interiors and design innovation. With an expansive lighting experience centre and an in-house manufacturing facility, we collaborate with architects and interior designers to transform spaces through exceptional lighting solutions. 
 The Opportunity 
 We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Backend Interior Designer who can support design development, prepare drawings and presentations, coordinate design requirements, and translate concepts into practical design outputs. This role is ideal for an aspiring interior designer who enjoys working behind the scenes on design execution, spatial planning, technical documentation and lighting-led interior concepts.

Maintain organised drawings, project files, revisions and design documentation. Support the planning and presentation of lighting displays within the company's experience centre.

Basic knowledge of SketchUp, Photoshop or other design visualisation tools is preferred. Understanding of interior layouts, materials, finishes, furniture planning and technical drawings. Good visualisation skills, attention to detail and willingness to learn. Strong coordination, communication and organisational skills. 
 Who Should Apply? Fresh Interior Design graduates with good technical and visualisation skills. Candidates with 0-2 years of experience in interior design studios, architecture firms or design consultancies. Candidates interested in architectural lighting, luxury interiors and premium design environments. Candidates who can join immediately or at short notice. 
 Preferred: Candidates currently residing in Mumbai or nearby locations who can commute to Vile Parle East. 
 Why Join Unilights? Work with premium decorative lighting and bespoke chandelier collections. Gain exposure to architects, interior designers and real-world design requirements. Develop your technical drawing, design coordination and lighting knowledge. Be part of a growing design-led business with opportunities to learn and take ownership. 
 Interested candidates who can join immediately are encouraged to apply.
